repository.title: Repository
repository.description: Web URL to the git repository

branchOrTag.title: Branch or Tag
branchOrTag.description: Branch name or tag (e.g. master). Default to master.

path.title: Filepath
path.description: The path to the file to fetch (e.g. docs/main/README.md)

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for HTTP basic authentication. Leave empty for public repositories. When authenticating with an access token, providers usually accept any value here, such as your account login or 'oauth2'.

password.title: Password or access token
password.description: Password (or personal/HTTP access token) for HTTP basic authentication. Leave empty for public repositories.

autoFetch.title: Enable Auto Fetch
autoFetch.description: Enable a periodic update of this documentation page

fetchCron.title: Update frequency
fetchCron.description: Define update frequency using Crontab pattern. Leaving it empty will not trigger any update. Note: Platform administrator may have configured a max frequency that you cannot exceed.
